raw:
@q query
  select ?t
  measure end
  where match
    relation "be the president of the board of the hospital"
    role subject "the new president"
    role object "Spitalul Clinic de Pneumoftiziologie «Leon Daniello» din Cluj-Napoca"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
